basic_data.description:
Level up your board game nights. We all love board games, but it can be tricky to find space to play and keep track of all the little pieces. That’s why we’ve teamed up with the folks at Marmalade Games to bring your favorite classic board game adventures to the digital realm! Hop aboard your fastest engine and cover the country in railroad tracks in Ticket to Ride! Find out whodunit, and in which room, and with what weapon in the murder mystery classic Clue/Cluedo! Make good choices and live your best life in The Game of Life and The Game of Life 2! There’s tons more digital board game fun to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and support Little Village with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 16th, 2027.

Pay €5.29 or more. Normally, the total cost for the games in this bundle is as much as US$283. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum €5.29 purchase. Pay €5.29 or more to access Steam keys.

Redeem on Steam. All of the games in this bundle are available on Steam for Windows — and some for Mac too.

Please review the system requirements here prior to purchasing.

Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the developer and to support Little Village. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too!

ppgf_info.category: Children and Youth Development,Society and Communities
ppgf_info.description: Little Village is like a foodbank, but for clothes, toys and equipment for babies and children up to the age of 5. We're a movement of parents committed to alleviating material poverty in London. Our dream is that no child in the capital grows up without essential items of clothing, toys and equipment. We promote sustainable living and make it as easy as possible for families to help each other.

clue_cluedo.callout:
Solve the murder mystery in this beautifully animated, modern 3D reimagining of the classic board game.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo.description_text:
Experience a fresh take on the classic crime-solving board game. Step into new mysteries and use your skills of deduction to find out who? With what weapon? Where? Join fellow detectives all over the world. Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects, and solve the original murder mystery.

Follow your suspects through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go. Play by the original rules, or try a new investigation format available exclusively to Cluedo. Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder your way and become the detective you want to be!

The complete ad-free original board game in stunning fully animated 3D. It’s the most iconic murder mystery of all time!

A Clue/Cluedo exclusive for crime enthusiasts - interrogate multiple suspects at once and run your investigation with more freedom and creativity than ever before!

Unlock layers of backstory, revealing information about the characters, their motives and alibis. Unlock every clue and earn bonus items, including premium dice and tokens!

The latest standard gameplay from Hasbro: when you roll a magnifying glass, draw a Clue Card and get free movement to any room, the chance to ask fellow suspects to reveal a card, and more!

Challenge AI detectives. Alter difficulty levels and tailor your investigation.

Join detectives around the world to interrogate suspects, gather evidence and solve the mystery.

Interrogate your friends, cross-examine your family, and unravel the truth.

For local multiplayer mode, download the free Cluedo Companion app to keep your Cluesheet secret!

What happens after Tudor Mansion? Find out in this NEW Crime Scene. How did every suspect come to be at the same resort at the same time? And who murdered Callan Coral?! There’s a storm approaching, and in the tropical heat a new mystery is unfolding.

WHISPERING PINES RETREAT
In another reality, six familiar figures receive invitations to an exclusive, luxury wellness resort. But one of them has manifested a murder! Figure out which guest murdered Mr. Bodden “Boddy” Black in this brand-new tale of blackmail and corruption set amidst a tranquil forest.

New Crime Scenes are coming, including Suspects, Case Files and more!

clue_cluedo_blackadderresortexpansion.callout:
Investigate the mysterious murder of Callan Coral at a luxury island hotel in this lavish new crime scene expansion.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_blackadderresortexpansion.description_text:
The tale continues beyond the shadows of Tudor Mansion and into the dazzling sunlight of the Black Adder Resort!

Mr Callan Coral, the manager of the Black Adder Resort and former business partner of Mr Boden “Boddy” Black, has invited everyone suspected of his business associate’s murder to lie low on his exclusive tropical island. Eager to get away from prying eyes in the aftermath of the party, everyone accepts the offer. However, things take a turn for the worse when they once again find themselves at the heart of another murder mystery!

Shortly after revealing his plans to his guests, Callan Coral is found dead in the hotel lobby…

This bundle also includes THE BLACK ADDER RESORT: REVISITED, which introduces two new suspects into the mix – Agent Gray and Analyst Hyacinth!

INCLUDES:

  • A BRAND-NEW EXPANSION – Explore the luxurious private holiday destination for the rich and famous in the Black Adder Resort!

  • Includes the Black Adder Resort board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a snake dice set and 12 new tokens

  • THE BLACK ADDER RESORT: CASE FILE REVISITED #1 – Think you cracked the case? Think again! Return to the Black Adder Resort and interrogate two new suspects who have murky ties to Mr Coral…

  • Includes two new suspects and four more tokens.

MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Unlock more case files with additional character profiles, evidence, motives, interview transcripts and more!

Close another case and boost your detective credentials with Clue/Cluedo!

clue_cluedo_classicedition.callout:
Experience the original hit digital adaptation of the iconic Hasbro murder mystery board game.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_classicedition.description_text:
Hello Detective

You’re invited to the most deadly party of the season! Join your friends and family, become iconic characters and enter the Mansion! Soon after you arrive the host’s body is discovered at the bottom of the stairs. The house is on lockdown until the puzzle is solved and the criminal is revealed.

Whodunit? With what weapon? Where? There’s six suspects, six weapons, nine rooms, and only one answer…

Play the part of an iconic guest!
Gather up to 6 players and become Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Doctor Orchid, Reverend Green, Mrs. Peacock or Professor Plum. Any one of them could be guilty, all you have to do is crack the case!

Roll the dice and move between the rooms.
At the start of each game, one suspect, one weapon, and one room will be removed from the deck, and the remaining cards will be dealt to the players. If you ask: “was it Colonel Mustard with the Rope in the Drawing Room”, a player holding the Colonel, the Rope or the Drawing Room must show you a card. Enter every room in search of answers!

Test your powers of deduction.
The virtual Cluesheet will automatically keep track of the cards you’ve been shown and cross them off your list, but you can add ticks and crosses of your own. Pay attention to what your fellow investigators are asking and who replies - you may be able to find answers without even having to ask!

Once you know the answer…
It’s a race against time! You must be on the scene of the crime to make your accusation, so roll the dice, get to the correct room and unravel the mystery! If your accusation is incorrect, you will be eliminated from the game. Don’t risk letting the criminal escape! Be sure before you show your hand.

FEATURES

• Online multiplayer for up to 6 players
• Single Player Mode against customisable AI suspects
• Private games with friends and family members
• Cross-platform multiplayer - play together with your favourite people on PC, iOS, Android and Nintendo Switch
• Out-smart fans around the world with weekly online leaderboards
• Unlock The Ultimate Detective’s Package for a selection of 10 themes that transform the suspects, weapons and locations! Travel around the world and back in time. Be iconic characters, and test your brain in wild places.
The mysteries are endless…

clue_cluedo_classicedition-theultimatede.callout:
Unlock all premium themes and characters for the Classic Edition.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_classicedition-theultimatede.description_text:
Take the classic Clue/Cluedo murder mystery around the world when you install the Ultimate Detective’s Package!

Gain access to 10 new boards and a whopping 72 playable suspects, including Mrs White, Madame Rose, Miss Peach, Monsieur Brunette, Prince Azure and Inspector Grey from the Internationals Character Pack.

Investigate a show-stopping murder at the Hollywood Studio, or head to the Vampire Castle for a monstrous mystery. Embrace nostalgia at the Classic Tudor Mansion, then scale new heights at Snowy Peaks.

Step aboard the Murder Express if you dare, then get ready for a showdown in the Wild West. Peer behind masks at the Masquerade, and behold ancient secrets in the Egyptian Adventure.

Don’t bury your head in the sand when you explore the Tropical Mystery, and finally, pit your wits against the legendary detective himself – Sherlock Holmes!

INCLUDES:

INTERNATIONALS CHARACTER PACK – Includes six new playable characters: Mrs White, Madame Rose, Miss Peach, Monsieur Brunette, Prince Azure and Inspector Grey

CLASSIC THEME – Includes the original Tudor Mansion board and six classic playable suspects: Miss Scarlett, Professor Plum, Mrs Peacock, Colonel Mustard, Reverend Green and Mrs White

HOLLYWOOD THEME – Includes the Hollywood Studio board and six star-studded playable suspects: Scarlett, Plum, Peacock, Mustard, Green and Orchid

VAMPIRE THEME – Includes the Vampire Castle board and six spooky playable suspects: Scarlett, Plum, Peacock, Mustard, Green and White

SNOWY PEAKS THEME – Includes the Snowy Peaks board and six cool playable suspects: Scarlett, Plum, White, Mustard, Green and Peach

MURDER EXPRESS THEME – Includes the Murder Express board and nine dapper playable suspects: Lady Scarlett, Lord Plum, Peacock, Mustard, Green, Duchess Orchid, Dr White, Peach and Maharaja Brunette

WILD WEST THEME – Includes the Wild West board and six rootin’-tootin’ playable suspects: Scarlett, Plum, Peacock, Mustard, Rose and Green

MASQUERADE THEME – Includes the Masquerade board and six mysterious playable suspects: Countess Scarlett, Duke Mustard, the White Twins, Cardinal Green, Prince Azure and Empress Orchid

SHERLOCK THEME – Includes the Sherlock board and nine elementary playable suspects: Sherlock Holmes, Professor Moriarty, Irene Adler, Dr Watson, Rusty, Miss Scarlett, Constable Plum, Peacock and Peach

EGYPTIAN ADVENTURE THEME – Includes the Egyptian Adventure board and six adventurous playable suspects: Meadow-Brooke, Scarlett, Plum, Peacock, Mustard and Green

TROPICAL MYSTERY THEME – Includes the Tropical Mystery board and six sunny playable suspects: Scarlett, Plum, Peacock, Mustard, Green and White

Elevate your favourite classic murder-mystery game with the Ultimate Detective’s Package. Discover every theme and suspect today!

clue_cluedo_noirmansionexpansion.callout:
Experience the mystery in a gritty, 1920s film noir setting.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_noirmansionexpansion.description_text:
The shadows over Hue County grow darker in the wake of a shocking murder.

Step into the elegant Noir Mansion and interrogate six suspects too sharp for their own good. They'll point fingers in every direction and offer up promises of honesty.

But you know better. Trust nothing but your clue sheet...

Could it have been Crime Reporter Scarlett with the Mini Revolver? Maybe Private Detective Mustard used the "Civil War" Musket with Bayonet? Did Risk Analyst Plum turn himself into a liability with the Billiard Stick, or perhaps Lawyer Peacock cracked with the Meat Tenderiser. Did Signature Forger White sign off Boddy's death with the Silver Candelabra? Or maybe Con Artist Green phoned in a deadly performance with the Rotary Phone...

With the Noir Mansion expansion, you can toggle the special Noir filter at any time during your game! See the mansion in its full-colour glory, or drench it in deep, cinematic shadows.

You'll also unlock Noir-themed cosmetics to dress up in true vintage style!

INCLUDES:

  • A BRAND-NEW EXPANSION – The highly requested film-noir theme arrives in Clue/Cluedo!

  • THEMED COSMETICS – This expansion includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a sleek dice set and 12 new tokens.

  • MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Delve into the murky backstories of each suspect and uncover their motives.

clue_cluedo_polarresearchstationexpansio.callout:
Solve the crime in the freezing, isolated quarters of a polar base.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_polarresearchstationexpansio.description_text:
At the frozen ends of the Earth, a cold-blooded murder stains the ice crimson!

Take refuge from the howling blizzard and head to the Polar Research Station, a remote outpost founded and funded by the victim himself, Mr Boden “Boddy” Black.

Search for clues in the claustrophobic confines of the building and examine six new weapons exclusive to the Polar Research Station expansion.

Did Security Chief Mustard silence Boddy with the Shovel, or did Journalist Scarlett sever ties with the Ice Axe? Did Climatologist Plum use the Harpoon Gun to hunt new prey, or did Consultant Peacock crack under Boddy’s scrutiny and reach for the Microscope?

Maybe Environmental Minister Green took Boddy’s final breath away with the Oxygen Tank, or perhaps Pilot White used the Welding Tool to seal his fate…

An all-new location, original tale and wintry cosmetics make this a must-have expansion for any Clue/Cluedo fan!

INCLUDES:

  • A BRAND-NEW EXPANSION – Brave the cold and make your way to the Polar Research Station to investigate the snowy scene of the crime.

  • THEMED COSMETICS – This expansion includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, an icy dice set and 12 new tokens.

  • MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Learn more about the eclectic cast as they come under pressure at such a remote location…

clue_cluedo_sherlocksuspectpack.callout:
Play as iconic characters from the Sherlock Holmes universe in your investigations.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_sherlocksuspectpack.description_text:
Two iconic mystery franchises combine with the Sherlock Suspect Pack for Clue/Cluedo.

Solve crimes as Sherlock Holmes, Professor Moriarty, Dr Watson and Irene Adler in this epic crossover. Each character sports an all-new design, creating an updated look that blends them seamlessly into the game you know and love.

As these characters aren’t tied to any expansion or case files, you can use them and their alternate-pose tokens right away.

Add the legendary cast of Sherlock Holmes to your next game of Clue/Cluedo and figure out whodunit…

INCLUDES:

  • 2 x SHERLOCK HOLMES TOKENS – Don the deerstalker and deduce who committed the crime as Sherlock himself!

  • 2 x PROFESSOR MORIARTY TOKENS – Sherlock’s archenemy arrives, bringing his cunning wit to the Clue/Cluedo board.

  • 2 x DR WATSON TOKENS – The ever-faithful doctor turns his attention to the problem at hand!

  • 2 x IRENE ADLER TOKENS – The only person to have truly outwitted Holmes, Irene Adler takes on the case!

clue_cluedo_whisperingpinesretreatexpans.callout:
Take the investigation to a luxurious, secluded nature retreat.

(Steam Deck Playable)
clue_cluedo_whisperingpinesretreatexpans.description_text:
A new story unfolds at Whispering Pines Retreat! A group of six supposed strangers seek refuge in the brand-new forest wellness centre, but things take a dreadful turn when they become entangled in a shocking crime…

Mr Boden “Boddy” Black personally invited each guest to his state-of-the-art retreat for some much-needed R&R away from their personal struggles – so which of them would decide to manifest his murder? And did it have anything to do with the true nature of Whispering Pines Retreat?

Six suspects, multiple motives and one victim – solve the case and become the ultimate detective in this all-new expansion for Clue/Cluedo!

INCLUDES:

  • A BRAND-NEW EXPANSION – Check in to Whispering Pines Retreat, Mr Boden “Boddy” Black’s wellness retreat, and take in the beautiful sights.

  • THEMED COSMETICS – This expansion includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a leafy dice set and 12 new tokens.

    MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Discover new backstories, motives and clues in an original Clue/Cluedo tale!

explodingkittens2.callout:
Betray your friends and avoid exploding in this chaotic, Russian Roulette-style card game sequel.

(Steam Deck Playable)
explodingkittens2.description_text:
The ultimate card game with friends is back with a bang, people! The latest version has it all – customisable avatars, reactions, emojis, oodles of game modes and cards full of quirky humour and animations sleeker than an oiled kitty with catnip-fuelled zoomies!

What’s that? There’s a particular card you’ve all been waiting for? That we’ve clearly forgotten to mention? Hmm…nope. Don’t think so…or maybe…?

The blazing legend of unfathomably volatile cats continues, and this time, you’ll feel the explosions reverberate through your dreams. If only there were some way to save yourself. Just nope right on out of there, you know?

The rules are still simple – draw cards, try not to blow up. Sounds easy, right? Well, obviously you’ve never owned a cat.

You see, tangled up in the deck are multiple fiery-furred kitties waiting to land in your hand and detonate your hopes of victory. Hope you have a Defuse card ready! The last one standing is crowned the winner!

EXPLODING KITTENS® 2 knows how to glow up right; bring back everything fans loved from the original, add in some upgrades and chuck more kitties in there. We’ve done that and more! More customisation! More explosions! More outfits! More kitties! More awesome graphics! More explosions! More ways to play! You won’t wanna say “Nope” to this!

Dress your avatar up in the season’s hottest outfits (cat hair not included)

Personalise your emoji set to ensure your trash talk has a razor-sharp edge.

Play alone against our expert AI or impress your mum with your sparkling social life by playing with friends online!

The mayhem comes to life with awesome animations! Those Nope cards just hit different now…

Find out more about the upcoming game on our website: https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/

explodingkittens2_beachdaypack.callout:
Hit the sand and bring chaotic feline explosions to the seaside with fresh tropical cosmetics, emojis, and a summery new card back.

(Steam Deck Unsupported)
explodingkittens2_beachdaypack.description_text:
WHY VIDEO-GAME BEACH TRIPS ARE SUPERIOR TO REAL-LIFE BEACH TRIPS:

🏖️ NO RISK OF SAND HAUNTING YOUR EVERY CREVICE FOR YEARS TO COME

🌊 NO MYSTERY TOE-TICKLERS FROM THE DEEP

☀️ NO RISK OF SUNBURN. UNLESS YOU’RE PLAYING OUTSIDE

🥥 DRESS LIKE A COCONUT AND NO ONE CALLS THE COPS

🌴 DRESS LIKE A SEAGULL WITHOUT THE ALPHA SEAGULL STRIKING YOU DOWN AS A THREAT TO ITS THRONE

(There’s no seagull emoji, you know. Unbelievable…)

Now that we’ve convinced you of the merits of a video-game beach day, it’s time to be ENAMOURED by the contents of this EXPLODING KITTENS® 2 pack!

INCLUDES:

TWO NEW OUTFITS – Become the seagull you always wanted to be with the Sea Rat outfit, or embrace your inner coconut and dress in the Glenn Coco outfit.

PINEAPPLE-BASED EMOJI PACK – Finally, someone answered the call for more expressive fruits.

BEACH-READY CARD BACK AND LOCATION – And not a single grain of sand in your unmentionables!

explodingkittens2_explosiveexpansionspas.callout:
Secure access to all future explosive expansions and chaotic card drops.

(Steam Deck Playable)
explodingkittens2_explosiveexpansionspas.description_text:
The boffins down at the Exploding Kittens® Emporium have made an incredible discovery.

It turns out, if you add kitty chaos to meowing mayhem, you get CAT-ASTROPHIC CARNAGE. (Side effects include dreadful feline-based puns. Bear with us.)

Now you too can experience ungodly levels of pandemonium with the Explosive Expansions Pass! This epic pass grants Exploding Kittens® 2 Superfans access to three huge expansions. Layer even more havoc upon the bedlam already available in the base game – why yes, we ARE running out of synonyms for “chaos” at this stage!

Imploding Kittens Expansion:

The Imploding Kittens Expansion introduces a new level of strategy and peril to the game.

Imploding Kitten Card: Unlike the Exploding Kittens, this card doesn’t eliminate you immediately. Instead, it’s placed back into the deck face up, creating a ticking time bomb that all players must avoid. When drawn again, it causes instant elimination.

New Card Types: Discover new strategies with cards like ‘Reverse’, which changes the direction of play, and ‘Alter the Future’, allowing players to peek at and rearrange the top three cards of the deck.

Streaking Kittens Expansion:

The Streaking Kittens Expansion adds an awesome new ability to the game – holding onto an Exploding Kitten card!

Streaking Kitten Card: With this daring card in hand, when you draw an Exploding Kitten card, you can hold it in your hand without going up in flames! But if someone steals it from you, they won’t be so lucky…

New Decks: Discover the Streaking Kittens deck, or ramp up the risk with the Danger Mode deck! Alternatively, chain up a ridiculous number of Attack cards with the Attack of the Attacks deck.

Barking Kittens Expansion:

Rounding out the Explosive Expansions Pass is the Barking Kittens Expansion! Add a sneaky game of chicken to your next match…

Barking Kitten Card: When you play this card, whoever is holding the other Barking Kitten card explodes! But if no one has its counterpart yet…you just made yourself a target…

Even More Decks: An incredible eleven new decks! From decks built around seeing the future to decks rigged with unnecessarily aggressive cards, this expansion delivers epic matches by the fistful!

INCLUDES:

IMPLODING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and increases the player limit.

STREAKING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and three decks.

BARKING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and eleven decks.

Get ready for CAT-ASTROPHIC CARNAGE with the Explosive Expansions Pass today!

explodingkittens2_mysticmayhempack.callout:
Add a dash of magic and mayhem with new cards and unpredictable effects.

(Steam Deck Playable)
explodingkittens2_mysticmayhempack.description_text:
👻🌛 It’s all back to haunt you this Halloween…

🔮 Those terrible card plays you made… The Madame Beatrice outfit lets you see them all!*

hasbrosbattleship.description_text:
You sank my battleship!

The official version of the classic Hasbro board game of naval combat is now on Steam! Challenge other players in Classic Mode or in the all-new Commanders Mode - a fast-paced, strategic and exciting variation. Play with unique naval commanders and use resources to activate powerful special abilities that will secure you a win as you wage war on the high seas.


Hasbro's BATTLESHIP features:

CLASSIC MODE
  • Faithful conversion of the classic board game
  • Head-to-head combat
  • Sink your opponent’s fleet before they sink yours
  • Call your shot and fire!

COMMANDERS MODE
  • Battleship with a twist!
  • A brand new, more tactical variation of the game
  • 3 new core abilities that shake up the strategic possibilities each turn
  • Unique special abilities for each Commander
  • New ship shapes to improve game play and the fun factor

COMMANDERS
  • Battle with commanders from throughout the ages

FLEETS
  • Each commander’s fleets feature unique and authentic art for each of the many warships! Watch as they come together in an epic clash of civilizations!

ARENAS
  • Deploy your fleet to every corner of the world and battle in epic arenas inspired by historical naval battles!

MISSIONS AND RANKS
  • Complete missions to earn medals, rank up and become the ultimate commander of the fleet!

SINGLE PLAYER
  • Battle against AI Commanders and raise your game before heading into multiplayer!

MULTIPLAYER
  • Take on a world of commanders all battling to have the last fleet standing and prove that you have what it takes to conquer the oceans!

Join us in Hasbro's BATTLESHIP now, and set sail for adventure, battle and glory!

thegameoflife.callout:
Navigate college, careers, and family in the classic digital adaptation of the original board game.

(Steam Deck Playable)
thegameoflife.description_text:
Check out our new game and discover new ways to win, in THE GAME OF LIFE 2 ! Get more choices and more freedom in the official contemporary sequel to the game you love.

Where will your choices take you? Find out in THE GAME OF LIFE!
THE GAME OF LIFE! showcases a beautifully rendered digital game board, cards and spinner that capture the fun of the Classic game full of adventure & surprises! THE GAME OF LIFE will take players on a journey where fortunes can be won…and lost! Choose a college or career path and start down the many roads of life, make money, buy a house or start a family -- will you take the safe route or the risky road? The choice is yours as you navigate life’s rich tapestry! Do whatever it takes to retire in style with the most wealth at the end of the game to win!


  • Multiple game modes for 1-4 players, including new, fast-play modes and single player mode
  • Save and resume in-progress games
  • Options enable game to be fully playable in English, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, German, Russian, Traditional Chinese or Simplified Chinese.

thegameoflife2.callout:
Spin the spinner and make modern life choices—from vlogger to eco-engineer—in this 3D board game sequel.

(Steam Deck Playable)
thegameoflife2.description_text:
THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is here on Steam (PC)! This digital board game is an official, contemporary sequel to the classic THE GAME OF LIFE game. It offers more choices and more freedom at every stage of the game on a fully animated and immersive 3D board. You’ve got thousands of new, meaningful ways to live your life before reaching the finish line.

THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is another one of Marmalade Game Studio’s classic board games for kids and adults alike.

Features
  • A CONTEMPORARY SEQUEL TO HASBRO’S CLASSIC BOARD GAME - THE GAME OF LIFE 2 drives the original from yesterday to today, with:
  • Customisable pegs
  • A selection of vehicles
  • An eco-city board
  • Second chances, including the option to change job, go back to school and get married later
  • New careers, including Video Blogger, Game Designer, Athlete and Dog Groomer
  • Pet adoption
  • New ways to win, including points for knowledge and happiness, as well as wealth
  • The chance to continue playing past retirement
  • OPEN ONLINE MULTIPLAYER - Distance doesn’t interrupt play when you connect with up to 4 players around the world
  • PRIVATE ONLINE MULTIPLAYER - Invite up to 4 friends and/or family members to a private multiplayer game
  • CROSS-PLATFORM MULTIPLAYER - Play on Steam, against friends on their phones!
  • SINGLE PLAYER - There’s no such thing as playing alone when you take on our challenging AI
  • PASS & PLAY - Simply pass the keyboard and/or mouse between players for an easy offline experience
  • SEASON PASS - Seek out additional boards, including ‘Fairytale Kingdom’, ‘Haunted Hills’ and 'Frozen Lands' with THE GAME OF LIFE 2 Season Pass to unlock themes, with 7 more on the way!

    How to play

    CHOOSE and CUSTOMISE your character!
    A life journey calls for one jaw-dropping outfit! Customise your pink, blue or purple peg with a style all of their own.

    START at the beginning!
    Teen life on the board might seem daunting, but there’s no pressure! THE GAME OF LIFE 2 game starts when big decisions really begin, and the choices just keep coming!

    Choose your LIFE PATH!
    Your life is in your hands! Get married, earn qualifications, become a star and adopt pets. In THE GAME OF LIFE 2 game the road has many twists and turns, and crossroads can now grant second chances - so it’s never too late to get married or earn that degree!

    Money vs Happiness, RETIRE your way!
    Are you in it for the millions or the good times? THE GAME OF LIFE 2 game is about so much more than money. Gain attributes for happiness, wealth and knowledge, and the final score will sum up your achievements!

    Earn REWARDS to UNLOCK new items!
    Unlock new characters, outfits and vehicles by playing the game and earning rewards! Collect 60 happiness points, travel 100 spaces, collect 5000k; each accomplishment unlocks a puzzle piece. When you collect 6 puzzle pieces you can unlock a bonus item, and there are eight to unlock in each world!

    EXPLORE marvellous worlds with THE GAME OF LIFE 2 Season Pass!
    Take an enchanted quest through the Fairytale Kingdom, become a Monster Herder in the Haunted Hills, discover the magic of Frozen Lands and live the life of your dinosaur-loving dreams in Age of Giants! THE GAME OF LIFE 2 Season Pass includes 4 additional worlds…

    ...with more worlds coming soon!

thegameoflife2-theultimatelifecollection.callout:
Unlock every magical and mythical world expansion, from the Lunar Age to Superhero City.

(Steam Deck Playable)
thegameoflife2-theultimatelifecollection.description_text:
If you already have THE GAME OF LIFE 2 game, this is your chance to get all additional worlds, including:

  • FAIRYTALE KINGDOM -Take an enchanted quest through the ‘Fairytale Kingdom’. Study at the Wizard Academy or become a Knight in shining armour!
  • HAUNTED HILLS - Will you test your tasty brains at the Haunted College, or go straight into a ghoulish profession? The choice is yours!
  • FROZEN LANDS - Get in your sleigh and qualify as an Arctic Scientist, or hit the slopes as a professional Snow Sledder! A sparkling snowy landscape awaits!
  • AGE OF GIANTS - Experience a fantasy prehistoric land where pegs and dinosaurs live in perfect harmony. Survive life as a Dino Dentist, or speed from home to home as a Raptor Postman. New prehistoric choices await!!
  • SANDY SHORES - Go on a forever holiday to an island where the sun never sets and the skies are always blue. Ride the waves as a Surf Instructor, or dive beneath them as a Marine Biologist.
  • LUNAR AGE - Launch into orbit and build a new life on the furthest frontier! Become a Spaceport Operator, or graduate from the Lunar Academy and be a Blackhole Explorer.
  • SWEET HAVEN - Float into a land of sugar and cheer and get ready to dedicate your life to the art of candy-craft!
  • All CURRENT AND FUTURE themes, outfits, vehicles and avatars!
Play now with your friends and family!

tickettoride.callout:
Build your railway empire across the globe in this stunning 3D adaptation of the beloved train game.

(Steam Deck Playable)
tickettoride.description_text:
Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride!

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way.

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace.

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard!

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic

  • Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map).

  • Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!

  • Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.

  • When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!

Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.

Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike.

Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure.

Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

tickettoride_roundtheworldticket.callout:
Expand your railway network with massive new maps and destinations from around the world.

(Steam Deck Playable)
tickettoride_roundtheworldticket.description_text:
To build the ultimate railway empire, you need Ticket to Ride ’s Round the World Ticket. With Ticket to Ride ’s Round the World Ticket, you’ll get immediate access to 10 expansions!

Visit Europe, journey to the Nordic countries, discover India, create your story in Legendary Asia, get groovy in San Francisco, explore Switzerland, holiday in Japan, experience Africa, bring passengers across Germany and connect countries in Poland.

USA 1910 Ticket Pack:

Travel back to 1910 America with more tickets and three new game modes: USA 1910, Big Cities and Mega Game.

Europe Expansion:

Play as Erika Ford and Bertie Hawkes as you tunnel through the Alps and claim ferry routes. Bonus content Europa 1912 Ticket Pack adds new game modes and tickets too!

Nordic Expansion:

Join Mina Larsen and Morten Jensen and ride across the northern reaches, connecting colourful cities in the snow as you go.

India Expansion:

Accompany Bhaskar Singh and Dr Aanandi Johri around the vibrant cities of India, crafting multiple routes to earn the Mandala Bonus.

Legendary Asia Expansion:

Make new friends in Wang Ling and Lê Chinh, add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet and aim for the Asian Explorer Bonus!

San Francisco City Expansion:

Jump aboard a tram or get a lift from fashion designer Summer Ashbury or silver-screen icon Felix Woods as you take in the city sights and seek out Souvenirs.

Switzerland Expansion:

Head out with photographer Ayla Vogel and watchmaker Elias Hartmann and connect Switzerland’s neighbouring countries.

Japan Expansion:

Work together with other players to build the Bullet Train network with travel blogger Nakanishi Kimiko and Gyōji Moriyama Isamu.

Heart of Africa Expansion:

Build your railway network across incredible new landscapes with festival organiser Blessing Kipruto and griot Nnamdi Okpara.

Germany Expansion:

Pick up Passengers when you join atelier owner Franziska Braun and scholar Reinhard Hofmann on a trip across Germany!

Poland Expansion:

Connect countries and collect valuable Country Coins as you explore Poland with talented make-up artist Regina Kamińska and energetic drummer Kacper Pawlak!

EACH EXPANSION INCLUDES:

  • An amazingly detailed 3D map

  • Unique new characters

  • New locomotives

  • New carriages

Your railway empire is history in the making!

There’s tons more digital board game fun to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and support Little Village with your purchase!
